rationale: C18 is a close, concrete drafting template for the child. Both are short proclamations terminating a bilateral trade agreement under section 350(a), and they use essentially the same sequence: identify the statutory authority and original agreement/proclamation; recite bilateral agreement on termination and its effective date; state the President's statutory power to terminate the implementing proclamation; and proclaim termination on a specified date. C17 and C21 employ substantially the same machinery, but their wording and additional predicates are less closely aligned with the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas, under the authority vested in him by section 350(a) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended by the Act of June 12, 1934, entitled "An Act to amend the Tariff Act of 1930" (48 Stat. 943), ... entered into a trade agreement with the President of the Turkish Republic ... and proclaimed such trade agreement by proclamations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas under the authority vested in him by section 350(a) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended by the act of June 12, 1934, entitled "An Act to amend the Tariff Act of 1930" (48 Stat. 943), ... entered into a trade agreement with the President of the Republic of Colombia ... and proclaimed such trade agreement by proclamation
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive near-verbatim opening recital, with the country, agreement date, and implementing proclamation details substituted.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas the Government of the United States of America and the Government of the Republic of Turkey have agreed to terminate the said trade agreement, effective August 4, 1952
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas the Government of the United States of America has agreed with the Government of the Republic of Colombia that the said trade agreement shall cease to be in force on and after December 1, 1949
shared_material.explanation: Parallel bilateral-agreement recital establishing the termination and effective date.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas the said section 350(a) of the Tariff Act of 1930 authorizes the President to terminate in whole or in part any proclamation carrying out a trade agreement entered into under such section
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas the said section 350(a) of the Tariff Act of 1930 authorizes the President to terminate in whole or in part any proclamation carrying out a trade agreement entered into under such section

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the said proclamations dated April 5, 1939, and November 30, 1939, shall terminate August 4, 1952
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the said proclamation dated April 20, 1936, shall terminate and cease to have effect at the close of November 30, 1949
shared_material.explanation: The operative clause uses the same proclamation-termination mechanism, adapted to different instruments and dates.
